purpose: Disprove rather than guarantee a fixed strategy edge; publish all outcomes, including negative, no-fill, unavailable and execution failures.
base_asset_note: DOGEUSDT is Dogecoin, not DOG Bitcoin Runes; DOGUSDT not listed on Binance Spot on checked date.
benchmark: cash=0%, 20pct single-buy-and-hold Spot at first eligible open, same simulated entry fee and spread; compare mark-to-market not liquidation
no_filtering: ALL 12 market/timeframe combinations included; absent pairs or invalid data remain explicitly FAILED, never dropped
guard: Positive backtest cannot certify prospective profitability; any realized loss retained; zero orders; no authorization for deposits
